Initial release of competitive-intel-agent with core features for competitor analysis:

- Profiles competitors using public web data (websites, pricing pages, product launches, job postings, press)
- Provides structured outputs: competitor profiles, pricing benchmarks, SWOT analyses, news/funding monitoring, and positioning matrices
- Supports common use cases: pricing analysis, market mapping, strategic board materials, and executive summaries
- Emphasizes ethical data sourcing (public only; no scraping behind logins)
- Includes sample prompts and output formats for rapid adoption in strategy and business workflows
